verdict.rationale: Airbyte's dbt Cloud integration explicitly allows dbt transformations to run immediately following syncs in Airbyte Cloud, which directly satisfies the story's core requirement of running dbt against freshly loaded data rather than a blind timer. However, this is documented only for Airbyte Cloud (not clearly for self-hosted/OSS), and requires the separate dbt Cloud product rather than native dbt-core orchestration. missing for 10: evidence of self-hosted/OSS support for post-sync dbt triggering, native dbt-core (non-Cloud) integration, and independent/hands-on confirmation that the trigger is reliable in production.
